| Status | `422 Unprocessable Entity` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/validation-failed` |

A query parameter, path segment or body field was read and then broke a rule: a `limit` of zero, an id that is not a number, a name that is blank or too long, an unknown `sort` key or `status` value, a required parameter or body field that is missing or blank, a query parameter the route does not take.

`errors` lists every rule the request broke, one sentence each, not only the first. Fix each one and send the request again.

For an import batch, a line that is JSON and breaks a rule of message-ir (a wrong field, a message before any header, a message without a `guid`, an old `schema_version`) answers this type, and `line` carries the first such line of the request body, counted from 1 with blank lines included. It is a line of the batch, not of any file: a client that packed the batch from several files turns it into the file and line it came from. An unsafe attachment path and a stated SHA-256 that is not 64 hex digits answer this type too, and `line` carries the line of the message the attachment is on. A batch never carries an attachment's bytes, so its `path` names no file on the server: only a `digest_sha256` already uploaded through `/v1/assets` finds the Asset. An empty batch answers this type without `line`.
